review.why: Writes nursing and healthcare resumes with exact licence status, clinical scope and patient privacy.
review.summary: Resume writing for nursing, allied health, clinical support and healthcare administration. It keeps licences, placements and scope of practice accurate, distinguishes student, supervised and independent practice, and forbids patient-identifying details. It says it is not clinical or licensing advice.
strengths: Clinical verbs and titles kept faithful to the real scope of practice
Strict rules against inferring licence status or eligibility
Privacy guidance, including rare events that could identify a patient
cautions: Jurisdiction rules for titles and licences are left to the user to confirm
